# Drakarian Services Inc.

> Montréal-based engineering automation consultancy that builds custom software, API integrations, CAD automation tools, and cloud data pipelines for manufacturing, R&D, and operations teams. Founded by Jean Blin des Doits.

Drakarian Services eliminates repetitive manual workflows for engineering teams. We specialize in three core areas: Engineering & CAD Automation (custom tools interfacing with SolidWorks, CATIA, and other CAD APIs), System Integration & Modernization (connecting legacy infrastructure to modern web tools), and Cloud Architecture & Data Pipelines (serverless architectures using Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Python). We also embed AI directly into automations — document and data extraction, intelligent classification and routing, natural-language interfaces, and anomaly detection — to handle the judgment-heavy steps that rule-based automation can't.

We offer flat-rate, tiered pricing with no hourly billing. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute discovery call. We serve clients across North America in both English and French.

## Services

- [Engineering & CAD Automation](https://drakarian.tech/#services): Custom software that interfaces with CAD APIs to automate simulation setup, batch processing, material assignment, and drawing generation.
- [System Integration & Modernization](https://drakarian.tech/#services): Data bridges connecting legacy systems to modern web tools and cloud environments.
- [Cloud Architecture & Data Pipelines](https://drakarian.tech/#services): Serverless architectures and automated pipelines using Medallion patterns (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers) for centralized reporting.
- [AI-Augmented Automation](https://drakarian.tech/#ai): Embedding AI into existing automations — document/data extraction from unstructured sources, intelligent classification and routing, natural-language interfaces over internal systems, and automated anomaly detection. Rule-based logic is kept where cheaper and more predictable; AI is used only where judgment is genuinely required.

## Projects

- [Automated CAD Flow Simulation Tool](https://drakarian.tech/projects.html#cad-automation): VB.NET application interfacing with SolidWorks API to automate thermal flow simulation setup. Result: ~4 hours of manual setup per assembly cut to ~10 minutes (≈96% less manual prep), launched in a single click.
- [BOM Pipeline & Product Configuration](https://drakarian.tech/projects.html#bom-pipeline): Serverless Azure Functions pipeline parsing massive XML exports to reconstruct 150% Bills of Materials, loading into SQL databases with Teams monitoring. Result: keeps 600+ products with frequently-updated nested BOMs in sync with zero manual hours — work that would otherwise require a 5-person team full-time.
- [Scalable Medallion Data Pipeline](https://drakarian.tech/projects.html#data-pipeline): Multi-tiered Bronze/Silver/Gold architecture in Microsoft Fabric with Python Notebooks, feeding Power BI via Direct Lake mode. Result: one source of truth across all tools, eliminating roughly one full-time data role of manual import/export and de-duplication.
- [Centralized Engineering API Portal](https://drakarian.tech/projects.html#api-portal): Internal REST API for a global lighting manufacturer, centralizing engineering data access and eliminating manual lookups. Result: a single source of truth that removes spreadsheet sync errors and stale records.
